question: vLLM Overhead 0.3GB 为静态估计，实际包含 Block Manager 元数据与 PyTorch Fragmentation，在长上下文（>100k）场景下因频繁显存块分裂，碎片化开销可上升至 0.8-1.2GB，导致可用 KV 显存减少约 0.5-0.9GB。

sources.snippet: This is a global gpu memory utilization limit, for example if 50% of the gpu memory is already used before vLLM starts and -gpu-memory-utilization is set to 0.9, then only 40% of the gpu memory will be allocated to the model executor.
